strategyReview: What is working: Weekend Hyperliquid funding reversion long remains the most robust live family (431 clean live trades, 70% win rate, +1.48 total; shadows 74% win), and monotonic arb/manual IV-touch rich NO are eligible but small-sample. What is failing: Gold one-touch/premium fade families are being traded as spot-directional signals and are losing nearly every test; the HYPE-confirmation BTC continuation family is firing into late-cycle exhaustion; raw funding-level reversal triggers without weekend or confirmation conditions are not normalizing reliably; and broad one-touch NO edge signals still have wide tail-risk losses in wide-spread PM markets.

failureClusters.theme: Gold premium edge misread as spot-directional short
failureClusters.evidence: find_0036 is 0/16, shadow_one_touch_high_edge_no_gold_heatmap_no is 0/20, shadow_no_bias_adjusted_gap_shadow_gold_short_rich_tail_no is 0/16, and gold_pm_premium_futures_spread_mean_reversion is 2/17. Losing examples include GOLD +8.74%, +7.35%, +5.37%, +3.97% against short calls.
failureClusters.recommendation: Kill or fundamentally redesign these directional short variants. The edge/premium is compensation for real upside drift, not a reversion signal. If premium decay is to be traded, it must be premium-neutral/hedged rather than a spot short proxy.

failureClusters.theme: Late-cycle HYPE confirmation long in BTC
failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion has only 6/22 wins. The setup fires when BTC is already within 4% of its 7d high and HYPE is above its SMA with stable OI; subsequent BTC moves were -2.93%, -3.47%, and +0.70%.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop treating HYPE stable OI as a continuation confirmation. Either fade the setup or require a meaningful pullback before considering any long.

failureClusters.theme: Raw funding threshold treated as normalization trigger
failureClusters.evidence: H-539/CBRS testing shows funding frequently continues lower after the trigger: 5.5% -> -13.7%, 5.5% -> -67.0%, 2.3% -> 1.3% against a long-reversion prediction.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require true weekend session, extreme percentile, and positive 24h funding change so the signal enters only after normalization has begun.

failureClusters.theme: Wide PM spread one-touch tail losses
failureClusters.evidence: Recent resolved ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows include GOLD -40.74% and BTC -28.26%; open warnings repeatedly show wide_pm_spread on tail one-touch contracts.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep enforcement on tight spreads/liquidity and edge gating. Avoid tail-barrier short premium when the contract is wide and price is close enough for gap risk.

This targets funding that has actually started to normalize rather than a raw sub-zero threshold.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS funding continues to normalize upward and CBRS spot/perp rises more than 2% within 3 days.

newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD above-strike YES premium decays without the underlying trending up, producing a profitable short in the one-touch premium/spot proxy within 3 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The tests score funding_normalize_up after entering on cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10, but funding frequently continued lower or moved sideways: 5.5% -> -13.7%, 5.5% -> -67.0%, 2.3% -> 1.3%. The raw threshold identifies a low level, not an exhaustion point, and the setup lacks weekend or recovery confirmation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The HYPE confirmation long fires after BTC is already near the 7d high. Recorded tests show BTC immediately fell -2.93% and -3.47%, or stalled below +2%. Stable HYPE OI was a late-cycle byproduct rather than a continuation predictor.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above SMA with stable OI confirms a >2% BTC long move over 3-7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Large GOLD underlying-cap edge on above-strike NO contracts was supposed to predict a >2% spot decline. Instead gold chopped or ripped: -1.15%, +0.37%, +5.37%, +3.97%. The NO premium reflected upside drift risk rather than rich pricing that would mean-revert lower.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The gold P/C collapse with PM settlement EV above spot did not resolve into a rally; outcomes were -0.82%, -1.11%, +0.18%, +1.04%. The signal did not produce the expected directional move toward PM settlement levels within the horizon.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Gold P/C ratio collapse below 0.65 with PM settlement EV above spot predicts spot rally toward PM levels within 7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts was traded as a spot short. The recorded gold moves were small or against the trade: +0.25%, -0.82%, -1.11%, +0.92%, +0.18%, +1.07%. The gap was not an exhaustion trigger.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Selling near-expiry GOLD above-strike YES on any positive sell_yes_edge_pts failed because the edge was not noise: gold moved +8.74% and +7.35% in the worst tests. Premium decay was swamped by real upside drift toward/through the barriers.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Rich near-expiry GOLD upside one-touch YES premium decays predictably enough to sell short.

journalEntry: Tonight's main lesson is that several GOLD premium/no-bias/one-touch edge families are not directional signals and should be treated as compensated tail risk rather than fade candidates. H-534, H-532, H-024, and H-567 all share the same failure mechanism: selling richness while spot is trending or near the barrier. I proposed a narrow H-567 refinement only where spot is below the 24h SMA and edge is at least 3pt; the others do not currently deserve further spot-directional refinements. The HYPE-confirmation BTC long setup is failing because it fires late; I proposed an inverse fade with positive perp funding as the exhaustion condition. CBRS funding needs a true weekend filter, extreme 7d percentile, and positive 24h change before funding reversion can be trusted. No parameter updates were made because realized payoff shapes do not yet support tightening or loosening stops/targets beyond current settings.
